issues.where: EP MAPS tiles (LAT, APD, PHASE), top of each 172 px map
issues.problem: The heart images are drawn on top of the tile subtitles. The LA outline covers 'ms' in 'activation, ms' and 'APD90-like, ms', and covers the middle of 'θ = atan2(v−1, u−0.5)'. The green 'PS 0/1' label also sits on the LV wall. It shows up in every frame.
issues.fix: Put a 14 px title strip above each map canvas, or shrink the heart drawing about 10% and shift it down so no tissue pixel enters the title row. Put the PS badge on a white pill in an empty corner.

issues.where: EP MAPS → LAT map during sinus rhythm (2 s and 52 s frames)
issues.problem: Half the map is grey: RV free wall, septum and atria have no colour, and the colourbar has no grey. The LV wall is blotchy yellow/green dots, not a smooth isochrone gradient. It looks broken or only partly computed, while the VT version is a clean rainbow.
issues.fix: Map LAT for every cell that activated in the beat window (RV and septum included) against the beat's earliest activation. Smooth or draw the 20 ms isochrone contours over it. If grey has to mean 'not activated', add a grey swatch labelled 'n/a' to the colourbar.

issues.where: Header QRS vital, beat card, beat table QRS column, event log (VT phase)
issues.problem: During VT the QRS reads '≥433', '≥439', '≥519 ms', which is equal to or longer than the RR. The QRS-offset detector clearly hits the end of its window (the LAST BEAT plot puts 'off' at the right edge). A cardiologist reads this as nonsense: VT QRS is about 140–220 ms.
issues.fix: Measure QRS width on the spatial vector magnitude (RMS of the 12 leads) with an offset search capped at about 0.6×RR. If that fails, show '>200' in warn colour, not a number tied to the RR.

issues.where: Beat table AX and TAT columns, header AXIS (19 s: −136°, 36 s: +21°), VT mean row
issues.problem: In a monomorphic VT with a fixed 433 ms cycle, the axis flips beat to beat between about −140° and about +15° (−134, +6, −154, +24, −159, +11…). TAT jumps between 107 and 358 ms or shows '--'. The 'VT mean −68°' is an arithmetic mean of a bimodal angle, so it means nothing. The numbers look like measurement noise, not physiology.
issues.fix: Compute the axis from the net QRS area in I and aVF over the same fiducial window each beat, anchored on the vector-magnitude peak, and use a circular mean for the summary. Compute TAT over one cycle aligned to that fiducial.

issues.where: Hero voltage map during VT (19 s, 36 s)
issues.problem: The title promises a spiral wave, but the hero only shows coloured bands sliding along a thin 26-cell ring around a small scar island. No spiral, no tip trail and no trajectory are visible. The 'ROTOR' label and leader line point at a spot you can barely see. For an X audience the money shot is missing, and most of the 680×700 tile is empty cavity.
issues.fix: Draw the phase-singularity trail (last 2 s, fading) and an arrowed circuit path round the scar. Add a 2–3× zoom inset of the scar and border-zone circuit with phase colouring so the rotation reads at a glance. Consider a thicker LV wall or a larger border zone so a real spiral fits.

issues.where: Header 'SUBSTEPS 30/frame · 15 draws' vs Workstation 'GPU SOLVER draws/frame 20 + 4 view'
issues.problem: The two panels give contradictory draw counts for the same solver. With 30 substeps at 2 Euler steps per draw it should be 15.
issues.fix: Bind both readouts to the same counter (15 solver draws, plus the view draws listed separately and consistently in both places).

issues.where: Workstation GPU SOLVER list (bottom), Action Potentials '3 s sweep' label, Restitution phase portrait x-axis
issues.problem: Text is cut off at the bottom of the tiles. A row below 'readback 61 KB / 2 frames' (heap / '0 MB') is half visible. The '3 s sweep' label sits on the card border. The phase-portrait loop and x ticks run into the bottom edge with no axis labels.
issues.fix: Drop or merge one GPU SOLVER row, or cut the line height to 10 px. Lift the AP axis label 6 px. Shrink the phase-portrait plot 12 px and add u tick labels.

issues.where: 12-lead ECG lead labels V1, V2, V3, V6 (and aVR) at the column starts
issues.problem: The black trace runs straight through the lead labels, so they are hard to read, especially during VT.
issues.fix: Put each lead label on a small paper-coloured backing pill drawn after the trace, or offset it 6 px above the baseline row.

issues.where: Controls: protocol timeline and S2 coupling slider
issues.problem: The playhead triangle overlaps the 'page 65.9 s' / 'page 81.9 s' label. The sublabels 'in 4.4 s sim' and 'delivered, CI 320' touch the slider thumb.
issues.fix: Move the page-time label left of the track, or clamp it to stay clear of the playhead. Push the slider sublabels 4 px down or put them right-aligned on the value line.

issues.where: Hero probe labels near the AV node, His bundle and LV endo
issues.problem: The 'AV' and 'His' labels collide with each other and with the AV-node ring. 'LVendo' sits on saturated red tissue during VT and can't be read.
issues.fix: Use leader lines to place the probe labels outside the tissue, with a white halo behind the text.

issues.problem: All nine electrodes (RA, LA, LL, V1–V6) read exactly 0.00 at the same moment. That is physically true in full diastole, but on a still frame it looks like a dead feed.
issues.fix: Show the band-passed lead value or one more decimal, or grey the readouts with an 'iso' tag when the tissue is fully at rest.

issues.where: Beat table / header HR during VT and the summary rows
issues.problem: RR 433 is shown as HR 138 (60000/433 = 138.6 → 139), while 431 shows 139. The SINUS mean axis reads '30' without the sign that every other row uses ('+30').
issues.fix: Derive the displayed HR from the displayed (rounded) RR, or show RR to one decimal. Use the same signed axis format everywhere.

issues.problem: A tall bar sits at the right limit (0.8 cells/ms). It is an overflow bin (Purkinje-driven breakthroughs) but reads as a real peak.
issues.fix: Label it as '>0.8' with a hatched overflow bar, or raise the axis maximum.

issues.where: Header between the rhythm badge (x≈840) and HR (x≈1075)
issues.problem: There is a 230 px dead gap in an otherwise dense header, which breaks the 'no empty corners' rule.
issues.fix: Put a mini 10 s lead II thumbnail or the protocol phase text (e.g. 'S2 in 4.4 s · shock in 16.8 s') in that gap.

issues.problem: The CPU name looks truncated (missing 'R' or 'Ryzen').

critic.summary: A strong, credible EP-lab dashboard. The light clinical palette, pink ECG paper and bedside-style vitals match the brief closely. The story (sinus → S2 → VT with AV dissociation → shock → sinus) plays out on schedule, and many numbers cross-check exactly: steps × 0.258 ms equals the sim clock, APD + DI equals the cycle length, QTc follows Bazett, and the restitution slope matches its fit. Frame 1 opens with full paper, a full log and charts that already have history. What holds it back: the hero, which shows thin wall bands and no visible spiral or tip trail; EP-map subtitles overdrawn by the map images; a LAT map in sinus that looks half-broken; and VT measurements a scientist would reject (QRS ≥ RR, axis flipping about 150° beat to beat, contradictory draw counts). There are also several small clippings and label collisions. Fix the majors and it is postable.
